title: James Allen death with heavy metals

tellings.quote: But then, uh, James Allen, the creator of the movie about Mark McCandish, uh, Zero Point or whatever, he died of an aggressive form of cancer and they found heavy metals in his autopsy.
James Allen, the documentary of Mark McCandish and the Flex Liner story, he was diagnosed and dead of an aggressive form of cancer in about 3 weeks.

as_told.title: Death of James Allen, the McCandlish documentarian

plain: A filmmaker named James Allen, who made a documentary about a man named Mark McCandlish and a story McCandlish told about something called the Flux Liner, is said to have died suddenly of an aggressive cancer. Michels says himself, without naming a source, that heavy metals were found at Allen's autopsy, and calls the film something like Zero Point. A guest who goes by UAPGerb, who appears as a witness on another episode, tells it twice and says Allen was diagnosed and dead within about three weeks, without mentioning heavy metals. It is told as one of the strange deaths among people close to the subject.
